full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Q0 is the sum of actual whole-table occupied floor-space area at unique first acceptance using cp_release; preserve original item areas through all later states. Manufacturing Q=Q0 and service original Q_H=Q0.

measurementRules.required_property: Actual geometry and independently measured mass
measurementRules.rule: Measure full floor-space outline and net complete-product mass independently by actual configuration/state; retain calibration, bark and surface/core moisture evidence. No nominal density, catalogue size or inferred mass.
Preserve mass kg, actual electrical energy MJ, transport t*km and actual service units. Convert real kWh by 3.6 once; integrate only a true rate, never a cumulative quantity twice.

For wood alone u=(wet-dry)/dry and dry=wet/(1+u); use representative independent moisture measurements, including core/shell gradients. Whole supplied formulations/outlets contain their carrier/retained water once; phases and reaction water need independent evidence.
Preserve each complete physical leg V_i and full raw/WIP/FG/asset/container wet stocks separately from burden vector A_i; economic attribution never shrinks physical exports or provider receipt.

calculationRules.rule: Convert original extensive raw units once to the actual row unit before attribution; MJ=3.6×kWh for real electrical energy. Integrate only true rates with time/state; cumulative quantities already integrated are not integrated again. Density needs independent substance/state measurement.

A_m_i = B_open_i + U_m_i - B_close_i - T_other_i. Vectors carry each exchange's inherited burden by cohort; B_close is raw/WIP and only unused/unassigned non-WIP stores/charges. First-released closing FG is excluded because it already belongs to Q. T_other requires a true other cohort/function and one justified allocation/handover; ordinary waste/reject/sale/treatment is not T_other. Already stock-corrected consumption enters once without another stock subtraction.

calculationRules.applies_to: actual original-cohort service burden dimension only
calculationRules.rule: A_s_i = C_open_i + U_s_i - C_close_unused_i - T_other_s_i. Include all actual performed service for the original Q_H over H; carry only unused/unassigned charge. FG held at closing does not subtract performed service. Keep original historical manufacturing vector separately with its original cohort, never repurchase a return or add it as new current manufacture. Unauthorized/failed work retains its actual increments and disposition.

calculationRules.applies_to: actual asset service burden dimension only
calculationRules.rule: Derive fulfilled service quantity and its one provider burden from observed utilization/capacity and justified exchange-specific attribution. Maintain complete physical asset stock separately; neither full acquisition mass nor economic share is a physical service flow. No fixed lifetime or assumed full-machine-per-m2 replacement; missing capacity/provider conversion remains unknown.

Set N_i = V_i, the actual complete external leg in the row's physical unit. Preserve full wet stock and real influx; remove only identical other incoming/outgoing terms. Do not apply manufacturing/service/asset stock correction or economic allocation to gross V. No procurement, duplicate provider burden or credit is created. Actual charge/fulfilled-service burden is a separate singly owned dimension.

Choose the one applicable numerator dimension: gross cards use complete N_gross_i; manufacturing burden uses A_m_i; service/charge uses A_s_i; actual asset service uses A_asset_i. Do not add physical-only disclosure to the burden inventory or apply allocation/stock correction to a gross numerator. Each ledger cell retains its dimension and cohort; split actual different cohorts rather than blending their denominators.

Q0=sum of original actual whole-table occupied floor-space areas at unique first acceptance; Q_c=Q0 for manufacture and matched original Q_H=Q0 for service/gross/asset accounts. Reconcile every original identity through disjoint net deliveries, all current accepted on-site states, irreversible losses and other terminal dispositions on original acceptance basis. Current shrinkage/repair/return does not reset area or create Q0. Zero or unknown Q_c retains raw totals and no unit result.

x_i = N_i / Q_c. This is the sole division by the first-release reference denominator, performed after raw unit conversion and the correct single attribution, or using complete actual V_i for gross cards. Cards and aggregation reference this already-calculated result only. Do not divide x_i again or shrink gross physical V; no unit result when Q_c=0.

calculationRules.applies_to: manufacturing FG-service and consolidated physical gates
calculationRules.rule: Independently reconcile opening full wet physical stocks plus every real external input with closing full wet stocks plus every real external output and separately evidenced phase/species change. Manufacturing first-release transfer cancels against FG-service reception in the combined gate; do not add it beside FG and G/R. Packaging P/I/ER/S/EO/W and repair-water X bridges remove overlap only from identical other flow terms; real influx retained in closing stock remains. Carbon/element/water closures use independent constraints; one residual cannot determine two unknowns.

collectionProtocols.collection_method: Use actual kiln controls/meters and representative independent core/shell moisture sampling with oven-dry reference checks suitable for the real section; retain full drying/defect history and failed cycles. Independently weigh condensate and determine its actual matrix/receiver. Reconcile complete refrigerant charge/service/recovery ledger and independently determined leak speciation/fractionation; no nominal leak or fresh-mixture factor. Analytical methods, recovery/detection limits, sampling coverage and uncertainty must suit the actual condensate/air/refrigerant matrix. An unvalidated assay or unknown essential method remains an unresolved result, never a software pass or invented closure. All actual utilities and species are separate atoms. For large wood items take representative cross-section sectors or subdivided increment-borer/auger samples with documented core/shell coverage; immediately weigh or protect samples against moisture change until weighing. Use an applicable documented oven-dry constant-mass reference procedure, with independently assessed volatile-extractive bias rather than treating all mass loss as water. Electrical meters require actual species/temperature/electrode calibration; a shallow or pinless reading dominated by surface layers cannot establish thick-trunk core moisture. Preserve observed gradients, sampling damage and every sampled/rejected body in physical and acceptance ledgers. Source lumber dimensions, temperatures, schedules, moisture recommendations and typical durations are not universal trunk settings. Thick timbers may remain internally wet and shrink later; kiln treatment and a coated appearance alone do not establish complete drying or acceptance.

measurementRules.required_property: 真实几何及独立实测质量
measurementRules.rule: 按真实配置状态独立测完整占地轮廓及整件净质量，保留校准、树皮和表层芯部水分；不设名义密度、目录尺寸或推定质量。
保留质量 kg、真实电能 MJ、运输 t*km 及真实服务单位。真实 kWh 按 3.6 只换一次；只对真速率积分，不二次积分累计量。
木材本身 u=(wet-dry)/dry 且 dry=wet/(1+u)，使用代表性独立水分测量，含芯表梯度。整份供应制剂或出口原含载水和滞留水仅一次；相态和反应水须独立证据。
完整实物腿 V_i 和全部原料/WIP/FG/资产/容器湿存量与负荷向量 A_i 分开保留；经济归属不缩实物出口或供方接收量。

calculationRules.rule: 归属前将原始广延量只转换一次至真实行单位; 实际电能 MJ=3.6×kWh。仅真速率按时间状态积分，已累计量不再积分。密度须该物质状态独立实测。
A_m_i = B_open_i + U_m_i - B_close_i - T_other_i。向量逐交换批次继承; B_close 仅原料/WIP 和未用未归属非 WIP 存储费用。首次放行期末 FG 已属 Q，排除于本扣减。T_other 须真实其他批次功能及一次正当分配移交，普通废物不合格销售处理不是 T_other。已库存校正消费仅入一次，不再库存扣减。

calculationRules.applies_to: 仅实际原批次服务负荷维度
calculationRules.rule: A_s_i = C_open_i + U_s_i - C_close_unused_i - T_other_s_i。纳入原 Q_H 在 H 内全部已履行真实服务，仅结转未用未归属费用。期末留 FG 不扣已履行服务。原制造历史向量在原批次另保留，不再采购退回品或当作当期新制造。未经许可失败作业仍保留真实增量处置。

calculationRules.applies_to: 仅真实资产服务负荷维度
calculationRules.rule: 从实际利用产能及有依据的逐交换归属得已履行服务量及唯一供方负荷。完整资产实物存量另记，完整购入质量或经济份额都不是实物服务流。不设寿命或每 m2 一整机替换，产能供方换算缺失保持未知。
N_i = V_i，为该行实物单位的完整真实外部腿。保留完整湿存量及真实入流，仅对相同其他入出项去重。毛 V 不套制造服务资产库存校正或经济分配，不产生采购重复供方负荷信用。真实费用/已履行服务负荷是独立唯一所有权维度。
选唯一适用分子维度：毛流卡用完整 N_gross_i，制造负荷用 A_m_i，服务费用用 A_s_i，真实资产服务用 A_asset_i。仅实物披露不加进负荷清单，不对毛流分子分配或库存校正。每台账单元保留维度批次; 真实不同批次拆开而非混分母。
Q0为唯一首次验收原实测整桌占地面积之和；制造Q_c=Q0，服务毛流资产账用匹配原Q_H=Q0。每原身份按原验收基准核对互斥净交付、全部现厂内验收状态、不可逆损失及其他终处置。当前收缩维修退回不重置面积或造Q0。Q_c零或未知保留原量无单位结果。
x_i = N_i / Q_c。这是首次放行参考分母的唯一除法，在原单位转换及正确的一次归属后执行，毛流卡则用完整真实 V_i。卡片和 aggregation 只引用此已算结果，不再除 x_i，不缩毛实物 V; Q_c=0 时无单位结果。

calculationRules.applies_to: 制造 FG 服务及合并物理门
calculationRules.rule: 独立核平期初完整湿存量加每真实外入，与期末完整湿存量加每真实外出及另证相态物种变化。合并门中制造首次放行交接与 FG 服务接收抵消，不与 FG 和 G/R 并加。包材 P/I/ER/S/EO/W 及维修水 X 桥只消相同其他流项重叠，期末留存仍保真实入流。碳元素水闭合用独立约束，一残差不能解两个未知。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 用实际窑控制计量和代表性独立芯表取样，以适用于真截面的烘干参照核对；保留全部干燥缺陷及失败周期。独立称冷凝液并确定真实基质接收。完整充注维护回收账与独立泄漏物种分馏核对，不用名义泄漏或新混合物系数。分析方法回收检出限、取样覆盖和不确定度须适合实际冷凝液空气制冷剂基质；未经验证测定或未知关键方法仍为未决结果，不能当软件通过或编闭合。真实公用物种均独立原子。 大木件采用有记录芯表覆盖的代表性横截面扇区或细分生长锥/钻屑取样；立即称量或保护样品至称量，防止水分变化。采用适用且有记录的烘干至恒重参照程序，独立评估挥发抽提物偏差，不把全部失重当水。电测仪须实际树种温度电极校准；浅层或受表层主导的无针读数不能证明厚树干芯部水分。保留实测梯度、取样损坏及全部取样失败木体于实物验收账。来源板材尺寸温度规程水分建议和典型时长不是通用树干设定。厚木材可芯湿并在以后收缩；进窑及表面有涂层不证明全干或验收。
collectionProtocols.unit: kg; m2; MJ; h; measured gas state
collectionProtocols.frequency: 每周期充注回收泄漏及结存事件
collectionProtocols.temporal_coverage: 完整生产及全部原批服务历史
collectionProtocols.site_scope: 实际窑室排水制冷空气门
collectionProtocols.quality_evidence: 周期日志；校准计量秤；有效水分分析法；真实取样；SDS；回收票据；完整充注库存物种核对

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 独立于名称分类核实整产品身份与全部原生材料形态路线品级地域介质type属性; 核心未决不用泛型部件替代，缺失辅料仍为具体原子。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 精确原生身份物性单位证据; 实际图纸 BOM; 供方匹配

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留完整适用 primary 和相邻反路线，区分整产品部件配方与 LCA 方法证据。家具标签或手册室内章节不是工厂配方或分配审批。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整来源; 用途限制; 实际厂家确认; 逐来源适用性

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 每配置校准几何及独立完整整桌质量水分; 真实原单位; 水分取样和该状态密度; 不推默认值，记录不确定未知失败。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 校准; 原读数; 取样组成; 核平

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 采启停空闲零产出清洗重工及普通废物处理、随货包材、所有原料/WIP/FG 历史和逐交换继承向量; 唯一分子及商。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整期间账; 上游所有者; 来源过程覆盖; 未决

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 毛质量元素水及每包材六腿/资产账独立于负荷份额完整。真实新增入流与完整期末湿库存同时保留，整份组分桥互斥。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 独立毛闭合; 分碳源; 相态物种约束; 出口供方一次

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 用真实原 Q_H/H、历史 FG 负荷及 G/R 身份; 保留已履行服务和所有失败未经许可真实作业; 合格须厂家规范许可及后试验处置。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 原放行; 匹配退回; 实际作业许可; 试验留置废物历史

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 诚实披露来源核心辅料供方数值物种未决; 不从工程检查主张科学翻译审批、生命周期等价或分类覆盖。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 元数据; 审查状态; 检查覆盖; 明确未决范围
